text: Architect: ADRs live in docs/adr/NNNN-<kebab-title>.md (Status/Date, Context, Options table, Decision, Consequences, Rollout); tools/check.py scans docs/**/*.md for links, so run `python3 tools/check.py` before opening the ADR PR.
child-page multi-batch migration issues: batch PRs reference the issue as 'Part of #N' (never 'Closes #N'), only the final cleanup PR closes it, so remaining batches stay tracked.
